jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Tin Can

Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We're creating screen-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today's digital world.

We're creating a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler & better for their kids than the tech-infused lives we're currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it).

As we gear up to reach more families both at home and abroad, we're looking to bring on someone who can build a lifecycle engine that stays personal even as we scale.



The Role

The Lifecycle Marketer is responsible for owning and optimizing Tin Can's email program, driving engagement, retention, and revenue growth through lifecycle marketing that feels as warm and personal as the connections we help families create. This role is both strategic and hands-on, leading the end-to-end execution of CRM campaigns in Klaviyo, from campaign planning and audience segmentation to automation, deployment, testing, and performance reporting.

The ideal candidate is a builder who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and enjoys balancing strategy with execution. Working closely with our Growth Lead, Brand, and Product teams, this role ensures every customer communication feels timely, true to who we are, and grounded in what the data tells us.



What You'll Do

 - Own the end-to-end execution of Tin Can's email program in Klaviyo, including campaign planning, audience segmentation, automation, deployment, and optimization

 - Develop and manage the email marketing calendar in partnership with Growth and Brand to support product launches, promotions, and seasonal campaigns

 - Build, maintain, and optimize lifecycle automations including welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, post-activation, loyalty and repeat purchase, referral, and other customer journey programs

 - Create and refine customer segmentation strategies to deliver personalized communications that improve engagement, retention, and customer lifetime value

 - Continuously optimize campaign performance through A/B testing of subject lines, messaging, creative, offers, timing, and audience segmentation

 - Manage subscriber acquisition, list health, deliverability, suppression strategies, and compliance with applicable regulations including CAN-SPAM, TCPA, and GDPR where applicable

 - Collaborate with Product to translate retention strategy into post-activation flows, onboarding sequences, and re-engagement triggers based on usage signals

 - Prepare regular reporting and performance insights, providing recommendations to improve conversion rates, engagement, deliverability, subscriber growth, and overall program health

 - Stay current on CRM best practices, lifecycle marketing trends, and emerging technologies to continuously improve program performance



What We're Looking For

 - 4-6+ years in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing

 - Deep, hands-on Klaviyo expertise: flows, segmentation, dynamic content, campaign deployment, and reporting

 - Comfort working across Shopify and non-standard purchase paths; you're not thrown by a customer journey with more than one entry point

 - Strong instincts for brand voice. You can take a rough brief and know when something reads as "too ecommerce" for a brand like ours

 - Experience working closely with design teams. You know how to write clear briefs so they understand what you’re asking for, as well as the self-confidence to kindly push back if the end result doesn’t meet all your needs

 - Analytical enough to read cohort, retention, and revenue data and turn it into a testing roadmap, not just a send calendar

 - A builder's mindset. You're excited to stand up a program largely from scratch, not just optimize an existing one

 - Strong, fast written communication and the organization to keep multiple flows, tests, and campaigns moving at once



Why Join Tin Can

 - We're building tech that protects childhood: We're on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.

 - Build something from (almost) nothing: most lifecycle roles ask you to optimize an existing program. This one is yours to shape from the ground up, with the freedom to define what good looks like and real ownership over the results.

 - A seat with real reach: your work touches nearly every part of the customer journey - giving you outsized influence over retention and revenue, not just one narrow slice of it.

 - Small, high-trust team: Every company says "team," but at Tin Can it means something different. We're a small, mission-driven group that genuinely has each other's backs — professionally and personally. Your ideas and instincts matter from day one.

If you're excited by the idea of shaping how thousands of families experience something simpler and better for their kids, please reach out. We can't wait to meet someone who's ready to jump in, set the bar, and help us grow.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIN CAN

Here at Tin Can, we're working to give kids the social independence we had growing up—without smartphones. We've built a remix of the classic home phone we had when we were young, but on a totally private network and with a bunch of added safety functionality (plus some fun surprise features in the pipeline).



We're building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler & better for their kids than the tech-infused lives we're currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to reach more families at home and abroad, we're ready to bring on someone to take our paid acquisition program from "working" to "unmistakably a machine."




THE ROLE

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to turn our paid acquisition program into a reliable, scaled growth engine. Paid is already one of our fastest-growing ways of reaching new families, and it's set for serious growth starting this Q4 and carrying into 2027 and beyond. The machine is built and it has real momentum—your job is to take what's working and make it a whole lot bigger.

This is a hands-on seat. You'll be in the accounts, in the data, and in the creative reviews—not steering from a dashboard three layers up.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own paid social on Meta. Optimize it continuously, using performance data to guide targeting, budget, and creative decisions—and stay ahead of whatever the platform changes next.

 - Keep the creative pipeline full. Partner with our in-house influencer team and external partners so there's always a steady stream of ads flowing through the account that perform and look like us.

 - Push beyond Meta. Test new platforms, scale the ones that earn their place, and build a diversified engine that doesn't wobble when one channel does.

 - Build the dashboards you need (if they don’t already exist, which they probably do) to catch what's working, and what isn't, in near real time with the support of an analytics team and tooling that make this genuinely painless.

 - Own budget planning and pacing across channels, allocating spend against performance and growth targets.

 - Partner with Brand to amplify bigger campaigns and moments through paid, in lockstep with organic, influencer, lifecycle, and PR.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4–6+ years in performance marketing, with deep hands-on fluency in paid social as your primary domain—and a reaction to new channels that's closer to "ooh" than "ugh."

 - End-to-end ownership. You've run a paid acquisition program yourself, strategy through execution.

 - Data and creative, both. You back every decision with the numbers, and you just know a good ad when you see one.

 - An eye for brand. This is a performance role first, but you're also protecting our tone and look as things move fast—catching what's off-brand before it goes live.

 - Low-ego and collaborative. This seat is highly cross-functional. You push for what you need while being respectful of everyone else's time and priorities.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL HAVE TO WORK WITH

 - Budget: The budget limit does not exist. If the CAC math works, we'll keep pouring fuel on the fire.

 - Data & Analytics: You won't have to fight for data. Between Hex and our existing dashboards, there's no ask too small and no chart too complicated to stand up—fast.

 - Creative: If the current pipeline can't keep pace with what paid needs, you have the standing to ask for more—and get it.

 - Growth: Grow the paid engine and the next step is building and leading a team of your own. This starts as a seat where you're doing the work yourself, with real room to grow beyond it.
   
   


WHY JOIN TIN CAN?

 - We're building tech that protects childhood. We're on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood—one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. This is a rare chance to build something that truly matters.

 - A seat with real reach. Paid is how most families meet us for the first time. You own that first impression and the growth that follows—not one narrow slice of it.

 - Small, high-trust team. Every company says "team," but at Tin Can it means something different. We're a small, mission-driven group that genuinely has each other's backs—professionally and personally. Your ideas and instincts matter from day one.



If you're ready to build the engine that introduces Tin Can to the next hundred thousand families, we'd love to hear from you. Reach out with your resume and a short note on the paid program you're proudest of—what you inherited, what you changed, and what it looks like now.

jobs.title: Head of People
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIN CAN

Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world.

We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler & better for their kids than the tech-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to scale to thousands of families, we’re ready to bring on a Head of People to help make it happen.




THE ROLE

Every promise we make to families is kept — or broken — by the people we hire. We’re growing fast, and the culture that got us here may not scale on its own. We’re looking for a Head of People who’s been through this stage before, someone who can help institutionalize our culture before growth dilutes it, and build every part of the employee experience (how we hire, onboard, pay, promote, develop, and support people) for the company we’re becoming.

You’ll have a seat at the table leading the company. You’ll take over from our fractional head of HR, and evaluate our current systems and practices, then develop the roadmap that builds the People function into an enabler of our growth bringing creativity & problem solving to deliver solutions. This is a role for a strategic leader who stays hands-on: you’ll architect the strategy, and you won’t hesitate to execute pieces (or all) of it yourself while you build the team behind it.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the full employee lifecycle — hiring, onboarding, total rewards, leveling, performance, development, and employee relations — along with the HR systems and tooling that run it, keeping what works and adding what we’ll need next

 - Partner with leaders across the company on org design and headcount planning, so our teams grow deliberately, not reactively

 - Refine the talent acquisition and hiring process with best practices that allow us to move fast and find the most qualified candidates, then enhance our onboarding so that new hires are set up for success from day one

 - Assess our total rewards and advise on our offering — compensation philosophy, bands, benchmarking, and benefits — that allows us to compete for top talent

 - Own HR compliance and administration as we add states, countries, employees, and contractors, partnering closely with Legal

 - Create a leveling framework, so promotions, hiring, and comp run off the same map

 - Stand up a consistent performance management framework and be the steady hand on employee relations: navigate sensitive situations and hard conversations with care, objectivity, and discretion

 - Measure the things that matter – identify the human capital KPIs we should be tracking at our stage, and use them to drive decision-making
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of People/HR experience, including building or scaling a People function at a high-growth startup

 - A high level of discretion, confidentiality, and ethics; people trust you with the hard stuff

 - Proven experience providing thoughtful guidance to a CEO and executive team; you see all sides of a situation and advocate strongly for employees while balancing growth, compliance, and fairness

 - Fluency using AI as a multiplier; this is how we work, not a nice-to-have

 - You can architect the People strategy and execute pieces (or all) of it yourself; capable of building and leading a small team as we scale

 - Comfortable letting people data guide decisions; engagement, attrition, and hiring metrics inform your recommendations, not just your reports

 - Working fluency in employment compliance across states and countries; experience supporting international growth, including resourcing outside the US

 - You’ve built comp bands, a leveling framework, or a performance management program and know what good looks like

 - Based in Seattle and ready to work from our office 4+ days per week; this isn’t a remote role
   
   


WHY JOIN TIN CAN

 - We’re building tech that protects childhood: We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.

 - You’ll own our number one bet: Institutionalizing culture before growth dilutes it is the bet everything else rests on — and every part of how we hire, pay, grow, and support people runs through you.

 - Small, high-trust team: Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.

 - Room to explore, not just execute: You’ll have the space to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and shape an employee experience that reflects our values of trust, simplicity, and care.

If you’re excited by the idea of building the team that brings a simpler, better childhood to thousands more families, please reach out. We can’t wait to meet someone who’s ready to jump in, keep culture king, and help us grow.
